name: Select2 Better Exposed Filters
description: Provides an integration between Select2 and Better Exposed Filters.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Description 
 Provide Select2 field widgets for forms and views filters. You can turn all 

 elements on your site into using select2 boxes by default. It can also be used for entity reference fields.

 Test the widgets on live demo here;

 https://select2.org/getting-started/basic-usage 

 Back to top 

 Fields with individual support 
 
 Content 
 User 
 Authored by 
 Taxonomy term 
 Lists (int/float/text) 
 Language 
 Languagefield 
 Country field 
 Address field 
 
 With some extra features:

 
 Preloaded entity reference options before user search 
 Limited visibility of search box by minimum list length 
 
 Back to top 

 Module integrations 
 
 Get flag icons in select list using Flags . 
 Get Select2 widgets in views filter using Better Exposed Filters . 
 
 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 Select2 library v. 4+
